revision_summary: One quote-timestamp error must be fixed: in script_coverage's bill_collection entry, the customer_quote 'It's showing me it has a little graph. It's showing me month to month.' is attributed to ts 03:22, but at 03:22 the rep is asking 'Would you be able to pull up one of those bills for me?' — the actual customer quote belongs around 08:04-08:09. Correct the ts field (or move end_ts) to reflect where this line actually occurs. Additionally: (1) reconsider bill_document_audit's 'received_on_call' classification given the numbers pulled were inconsistent/unconfirmed and the call dropped before resolution — 'partial/unconfirmed' is more accurate; (2) surface the flat-rate/autopay disclosure at 05:37 ('I paid the same thing every month... this info pen thing') since it undermines treating $527/$170 as clean bill-pain anchors — this should be noted in bill_anchor_audit or cherry_pick_moments; (3) tighten schema citations — analysis_directives.knowledge_gap_handling doesn't cleanly fit the 00:52 internal-hold moment, and protocols.button_up.is_that_fair_handshake doesn't fit a call that never reached booking; use more general/accurate schema anchors or note the gap explicitly. These are targeted fixes, not a full rerun — the trajectory read, outcome dispute, and overall structure are sound.
